geometry.selection: LMC catalogue bounds: RA 65..100, declination -75.5..-62 degrees. MAGMA replaces covered NANTEN parents without adding the same mass twice.
geometry.geometrySource: Catalogue positions and sizes, DeMCELS shell/knot/filament parameters, smooth published disc/bar/warp. No Horálek pixels enter density or color structure.

agePriors.spectrum: BC03 Z=0.008; nearest tabulated age, fixed before grading
agePriors.meaning: Color priors only. Missing catalogue ages remain null and are never presented as measurements.

geometry.depthStatus: Unmeasured centre heights use deterministic adopted population dispersions; ellipsoid depth is the geometric mean transverse radius. Individual 3D distances are not claimed.
geometry.dustMixture: Molecular mass from NANTEN, refined by MAGMA islands; smooth atomic-disc mass 3.8e8 Msun at 50 kpc from Staveley-Smith 2003. One Bell column normalization follows.

photoRole: Per-catalogue-object luminosity and per-component color calibration only; no pixel transfer.
